text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Billing metering anomaly detected: token-count drift (EU, emitter-agg) exceeding 3% threshold over 10m. Potential delayed emits + overage flags. Paging oncall.

maria: ack — I'm oncall, looking now. Can someone paste the quick query for emitter lag?

sam: pasting minimal check: `SELECT region, sum(tokens_emitted) FROM emitter_agg WHERE ts > now() - interval '15m' GROUP BY region;`

sam: EU shows a ~40% drop vs rolling baseline, but shadow counts still reporting. Logs show backpressure at emitter-processor-3.

raj: seeing lots of `WARN kafka.consumer.process lag=12000` in emitter-processor logs. Reproducer snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] WARN emitter-processor-3 - commit timeout, processing backlog=12400, partition=eu-usage-12
[2026-03-18T09:12:10Z] ERROR emitter-processor-3 - failed to ack 3 messages -> temporary backoff
```

emily: could be transient disk throttle on node g4-eu-07, CPU fine but iostat shows high avgq. Ops alerted autoscaler but pod stayed in CrashLoop for a few mins earlier.

maria: timeline — customers started seeing delayed usage reports ~09:10Z, overage flags fired at 09:18Z for a subset. Are these actual overcharges or false positives?

billing-eng: initial check: flags were triggered by threshold window closing without the late emits. Many of the flagged accounts have shadow counts that will reconcile once backfill runs. Recommend pausing customer overage notifications until reconciliation.

sam: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) route incoming emitter traffic to standby processor (eu-emitter-standby), 2) throttle flagging job for 30m, 3) kick off backfill for 09:00-09:30 window.

maria: +1. Can ops flip routing? If so, do we have a safe command?

raj: runbook command (safe patch):
```
# cordon problem pod
kubectl scale deploy emitter-processor --replicas=0 -n eu-prod --selector=state=primary
# scale standby
kubectl scale deploy emitter-processor-standby --replicas=3 -n eu-prod
```

raj: I'll run the scale now, will watch Kafka consumer group rebalance.

raj: running...

incident-bot: Deploy-bot: Successful scale: emitter-processor (0 -> 0), emitter-processor-standby (1 -> 3).

sam: consumer lag improving: `consumer_lag{group="emitter-eu"} -> 4000 -> 600` in 90s. Good.

emily: node g4-eu-07 shows disk ops returning to normal after ejecting the primary pod. No more i/o stalls.

billing-eng: pausing overage notifications via job toggle: `POST /internal/flags/pause?reason=emitter_delay` — toggled, will expire in 60m.

maria: starting backfill for 09:00-09:30 window now. Command: `python tools/backfill.py --start 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z --end 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z --region eu`

sam: backfill logs: first batch queued, 0 errors so far. ETA ~12m for full reconciliation.

maria: customer comms — recommend temporary notice: "We detected delayed usage reporting for EU customers around 09:10Z; automated reconciliation is in progress and no billing adjustments will be applied during this window. We'll follow up when counts are reconciled." Approve?

billing-eng: approve. Also recommend proactively applying credits if any customer's bill shows an overage after reconciliation. We'll prepare a claims list.

raj: monitoring: token emission gap now closed to <2% of baseline. Will keep standby scaled for 30m.

emily: creating an incident ticket: INC-2026-03018 with root cause hypothesis = emitter-processor disk throttling + consumer commit timeouts. Adding logs and metrics.

maria: oncall handoff: I'll remain primary until counts fully reconciled and backfill completes. If backfill finishes and we confirm reconciliation, i'll hand to day shift @sam at 10:15Z.

sam: ack. I will take over at 10:15Z for post-incident analysis and customer follow-up.

incident-bot: NOTE — backfill completed at 09:24:11Z, reconciled 98% of delayed tokens. Remaining ~2% under investigation.

maria: verified shadow counts match ledger for 09:00-09:30 aside from a small tail. Moving to planning: schedule deep-dive with infra + billing for 13:00Z.

billing-eng: preparing crediting plan and final customer message draft.

maria: closing live pager. Will post summary in #postmortems when deep-dive done. Thanks team :heart:
